summary: EFCAR, LLC filed an 8-K reporting the retention of counsel and filing of legal opinions related to a shelf registration statement for asset-backed securities. The filing describes the issuance of Class A-1, A-2, and A-3 notes totaling ~$242.86 million in an Exeter Select Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-1 securitization. No corporate event triggering a special situation occurs; this is a routine structured finance offering. The registrant is the depositor/sponsor of a securitization trust, not party to an acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring event. The filing serves only to update legal opinions on an existing shelf registration.
